chunks: And with this chain, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Barqi, from his father, from 'Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musdaq ibn Sadaqah, from 'Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati, who said:

I was in the presence of Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him). A man said, 'O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the household of Muhammad.' Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to him, 'O man, you have narrowed [the scope] upon us. Do you not know that the Ahl al-Bayt are five, the People of the Cloak?' The man asked, 'How should I say?' He (peace be upon him) replied, 'Say: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family (Al) of Muhammad, so that we and our Shias will be included in it.'

key_terms.آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ: The Family of Muhammad (broader term including the Imams and their followers)
key_terms.أَصْحَابُ الْكِسَاءِ: The People of the Cloak (referring to the five infallibles)
key_terms.أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ: The Household (often referring specifically to the five members of the Cloak in this context)

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between saying 'Ahl al-Bayt' and 'Al Muhammad' in salutations according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration to highlight the theological precision in supplicatory language, where 'Ahl al-Bayt' is understood in its specific sense of the five infallibles (Ahl al-Kisa), while 'Al Muhammad' encompasses the broader lineage including the Imams and their followers. This distinction underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the universal scope of the Prophet's family in intercessory prayers, ensuring that the supplicant's intent covers both the specific Ahl al-Kisa and the wider community of the Shia. The instruction reflects the practical application of Quranic verses regarding the purification of the Ahl al-Bayt, linking linguistic choice to spiritual efficacy.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 3. And from the previous chain from Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah al-Barqi from his father from ’Amru b. Sa’eed from Musdaq b. Sadaqah from Ammar b. Musa al-Sabati who said:

“I was in the presence of Abi Abdillah (a.s.), thus a person said, "O Allah, send your blessings upon Muhammad and the household (i.e. Ahl al-Bayt) of Muhammad." So Abu Abdullah (a.s.) said to him: "O man, you have excluded us. Don’t you know that the household are five [which are] the people of the cloak?” He asked, “How should I say?” He (a.s.) replied, “Say: O Allah, send your blessings upon Muhammad and the family (i.e. Al) of Muhammad, and so, we and our Shias are included in it.”
